No numerical replay, registry mutation, maximum-domain inference, or leaf admission.

literal_dependency_binding.target_checked: Mub6.NoFourMUB6 is definitionally not-exists B : Fin 4 -> BasisMatrix, Mub6.IsMUBQuartet B; IsMUBQuartet retains orthonormality of all four bases and unbiasedness for every ordered distinct pair.

semantic_findings.finding: The normalization uses a common unit row phase and independent unit ray phases through Mub6.quartet_rephase. In this instance the common row phase is one. The resulting dephasedQuartet still satisfies the literal IsMUBQuartet predicate, so all four bases and all distinct pairwise unbiasedness statements survive.

The phase-scaled 0-1 overlap has unit norm from squared overlap 1/6. The explicit ray phases produce the stated dephased overlap, whose first row and first column are one. The chosen four coordinates are actual entries of that normalized physical edge.

Every unit phase receives its exact principal Complex.arg representative. The proved inequalities place every coordinate in the whole closed rational box [-4,4]^4. Both -4 and +4 root faces were independently kernel checked as included; there is no omitted phase seam.

Box membership is closed. Exact split equivalence requires lower <= cut <= upper; CertifiedTree.split stores both guards. The cut face belongs to both children, including endpoint cuts. Fresh negative controls prove that children cut at +5 and -5 are not included in the [-4,4] parent, confirming the guards are material.

CertifiedTree coverage preserves the identical point and identical predicate. A closed leaf requires a literal proof of no Live point, and reuse requires inclusion of the smaller box in the reused outer box. No Boolean or native acceptance is a constructor.

QuartetPhasePopulation contains every normalized quartet edge and has no maximum, corner-selection, strict-D0, or external-worklist field. No global-maximum domain statement can be inferred from this bridge.
